detail.longDescription: Gemini CLI tip: it joins every GEMINI.md it finds (~/.gemini, your project and its parents, plus folders the agent touches) and sends them all, so a global rule and a project rule that disagree are both in context. /memory show prints the combined text. Already have AGENTS.md? Import it with @./AGENTS.md or set context.fileName. 6 GEMINI.md files to copy: https:// agentkitco.com/blog/gemini-md- examples/ # GeminiCLI # AI # Programming
